entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The lake was a huge curtain of shimmering silver.
entries.zh: 湖里是一扇巨大的银幕

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The cold, clear water of the stream wound down the mountainside.
entries.zh: 溪水清凉清凉,伤于山坡下.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He could hear the soft bubbling of a stream in the distance.
entries.zh: 他能听到远处的溪流的柔软声

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The water in the lake was calm and crystal clear and sparkled with a million diamonds of light in the midday sun.
entries.zh: 湖中的水很平静,水晶清澈,在中午的阳光下闪烁着百万颗光钻石.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Shimmering in the flickering starlight, the river was a long, snaking, silver ribbon.
entries.zh: 在闪烁的星光中闪烁, 河流是一个长长的, 裸露的,银色的丝带。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The mountain streams made winding lines of sparkling silver as they danced down the slopes.
entries.zh: 山溪在山坡下跳舞时 制造了闪闪发光的银线

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: There was a trickle of running water as the river flowed down the hill as dozens of little waterfalls.
entries.zh: 当河水流下丘陵时,有一小瀑布数十处,流淌着流水。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: From every hill came the gurgling of water – the music of invisible fountains as the river tumbled down the slopes.
entries.zh: 每座山都涌来水的涌动——随着河水从山坡上涌下,隐形喷泉的音乐.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The waterfall was a silky, watery stairs that whispered as it fell.
entries.zh: 瀑布是一个丝绸的,水密的楼梯,在坠落时悄悄地发出声音.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was surrounded by a curtain of dancing water, which sent a spray like thousands of tiny diamonds dropping from the sky.
entries.zh: 他被一扇舞水的窗帘包围着, 喷出的喷雾像从天而降的数千颗小钻石。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Clear and as smooth as glass, the stream twisted and turned through the forest.
entries.zh: 清澈光滑如玻璃 溪流扭曲 穿过森林

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The river was swollen and flooding its banks.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The grey, churning water of the lake blended with the stormy sky.
entries.zh: 湖里的灰色,清澈的水 与暴风雨的天空混合

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: From below came the deadly sound of roaring rapids.
entries.zh: 从下面传来了咆哮的快速声

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The lake was long and narrow and wound between the towering, ghostly mountains.
entries.zh: 湖面长而狭长,高耸的幽灵山之间有伤口.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The river was brown and frothing, polluted by rubbish and chemicals.
entries.zh: 这条河是棕褐色的和皱纹的,被垃圾和化学品污染。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was impossible to see anything in the murky depths of the oily river.
entries.zh: 油腻河水深处 无法见到任何东西

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The wild current swept past and flung the water into the air as it tumbled over the edge.
entries.zh: 狂野的洋流横扫过去 把水扔到空中 当它翻过边缘时

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A torrent of water thundered endlessly over the lip of the rock and filled the river with its hammering roar.
entries.zh: 一阵水雷在岩石的嘴唇上无休止地打响 河里充满了它的锤子咆哮

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The water was turned into wild, flying foam as it rampaged down the rocks.
entries.zh: 水变成野生的 飞翔的泡沫 当它冲下岩石时

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Roaring fiercely, the river hurtled over the edge into the swirling mist below.
entries.zh: 猛烈的咆哮,河水在边缘上触动,进入下面的旋涡雾.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She had dived into an eerie world: an underwater forest of murky, green water, strangled by a spidery web of weeds.
entries.zh: 她潜入了一个阴险的世界: 一片水下森林, 绿水密布, 被一群蜘蛛网勒死。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Torrents of water plunged over the top of the cliffs into the once calm waterhole, turning into a raging, foaming falls and sending huge clouds of spray hundreds of feet into the air.
entries.zh: 水的种子从悬崖的顶部滑入一度平静的水洞,变成狂暴的,泡沫般的瀑布,向空气中喷出巨大的喷雾数百英尺.
